### Load library

### Read data from GitHub

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acatlin/data/refs/heads/master/penguin_predictions.csv"

df <- read_csv(
  file = url,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE, 
  skip = 10
)
glimpse(df)
```
